```{r setup, include=FALSE}
                      message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(spatialss)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(spdep)
library(splm)
library(plm)
library(texreg)
```

## 加载 Chen CJIP 面板数据

```{r}
data <- load_chen_cjip()
dim(data)
length(unique(data$cowcode))
length(unique(data$year))
```

## 转换为平衡面板

```{r}
data_balanced <- make.pbalanced(data, index = c("cowcode", "year"),
                                 balance.type = "shared.individuals")
length(unique(data_balanced$cowcode))
length(unique(data_balanced$year))
```

## 准备空间权重矩阵

```{r}
dist_w <- load_dist_weights()

# 400km 阈值
dist_w400 <- dist_w
dist_w400[dist_w400 <= 400] <- 1
dist_w400[dist_w400 > 400] <- 0
diag(dist_w400) <- 0

# 移除孤岛
omits <- which(rowSums(dist_w400) == 0)
dist_w400 <- dist_w400[-omits, -omits]
dist_w400_rstd <- dist_w400 / rowSums(dist_w400)
dim(dist_w400_rstd)

# 筛选数据匹配权重矩阵
data_balanced <- data_balanced |>
  filter(cowcode %in% as.numeric(rownames(dist_w400_rstd))) |>
  arrange(cowcode, year)
dim(data_balanced)
```

## 因变量的空间依赖性检验

```{r fig.align='center', fig.cap="因变量的空间依赖检验", out.width="80%"}
years <- unique(data_balanced$year)
moran_results <- lapply(years, function(yr) {
  df_slice <- data_balanced |> filter(year == yr)
  ape::Moran.I(df_slice$logidealdistance, weight = dist_w400_rstd)
})

mat <- sapply(moran_results, unlist)
colnames(mat) <- years
rownames(mat) <- c("Observed", "Expected", "sd", "p.value")

mat_df <- as.data.frame(t(mat))
mat_df$year <- rownames(mat_df)

df_moran <- gather(mat_df, key = "Type", value = "Moran", Observed:Expected)

ggplot(df_moran, aes(x = year, y = Moran, group = Type, linetype = Type)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line() +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = seq(1979, 2014, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Moran's I") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 10))
```

## 普通面板模型

```{r}
formula <- logidealdistance ~ laglogidealdistance + statefrom.total +
  logpop + loggdppc + tradependonCHN + v2x_polyarchy +
  capratio + dip_hist + solschange

# 混合 OLS
model_pooling <- plm(formula, data = data_balanced,
                     index = c("cowcode", "year"), model = "pooling")

# 固定效应
model_fe <- plm(formula, data = data_balanced,
                index = c("cowcode", "year"), model = "within")
```

## 面板残差空间依赖性检验

```{r}
rwtest(formula, data = data_balanced, w = dist_w400_rstd,
       index = c("cowcode", "year"))
```

## 创建空间滞后项

```{r}
data_lag <- data_balanced |>
  arrange(cowcode, year) |>
  group_by(cowcode) |>
  mutate(time_order = row_number()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(year, cowcode) |>
  mutate(
    splag_x = as.vector(kronecker(diag(1, 36), dist_w400_rstd) %*% statefrom.total),
    splag_y = as.vector(kronecker(diag(1, 36), dist_w400_rstd) %*% logidealdistance)
  ) |>
  arrange(cowcode, year)
```

## 空间 OLS (SLX 与 Wy)

```{r}
fm_WX <- plm(logidealdistance ~ laglogidealdistance + statefrom.total +
              logpop + loggdppc + tradependonCHN + v2x_polyarchy +
              capratio + dip_hist + solschange + splag_x,
             data = data_lag, index = c("cowcode", "year"), model = "within")

fm_Wy <- plm(logidealdistance ~ laglogidealdistance + statefrom.total +
              logpop + loggdppc + tradependonCHN + v2x_polyarchy +
              capratio + dip_hist + solschange + splag_y,
             data = data_lag, index = c("cowcode", "year"), model = "within")
```

## 固定效应空间面板模型 (ML)

```{r}
data_complete <- data_balanced |>
  select(cowcode, year, logidealdistance, statefrom.total,
         logpop, loggdppc, tradependonCHN, v2x_polyarchy,
         capratio, dip_hist, solschange) |>
  na.omit()

model1_fe <- spml(logidealdistance ~ statefrom.total +
                   logpop + loggdppc + tradependonCHN + v2x_polyarchy +
                   capratio + dip_hist + solschange,
                  data = data_complete,
                  listw = mat2listw(dist_w400_rstd, style = "W"),
                  model = "within",
                  spatial.error = "none", lag = TRUE)
summary(model1_fe)
```

## 随机效应空间面板模型

```{r}
model2_re <- spml(logidealdistance ~ statefrom.total +
                   logpop + loggdppc + tradependonCHN + v2x_polyarchy +
                   capratio + dip_hist + solschange,
                  data = data_complete,
                  listw = mat2listw(dist_w400_rstd, style = "W"),
                  model = "random",
                  spatial.error = "none", lag = TRUE)
summary(model2_re)
```

## 模型比较

```{r results='asis'}
texreg(list(model_pooling, model_fe, fm_WX, fm_Wy),
       custom.model.names = c("OLS", "FE", "WX", "Wy"),
       stars = c(0.01, 0.05, 0.1),
       caption = "面板数据空间模型比较")
```
